reading.title: Spatial Relations 1: A short reading
reading.text: Maya compares two meeting rooms. One is large and wide, while the other is small and narrow. The large room is close to the entrance. The smaller room is far away, beside the storage area. Maya chooses the nearby room because visitors will find it more easily. Omar helps her arrange the chairs.

reading.text: Omar moves a box from a high shelf to a low one. It was out of reach, but now it is within reach. Maya places a shallow tray beside a deep bowl. They keep the table level and flat. A tall cabinet stays at the back so it will not block the window.

reading.text: Maya arranges papers in stacked trays. The files are aligned, but loose notes are scattered across the desk. Omar draws a horizontal line and a vertical line on the board.
